plainText:
The Village of Dragons (Japanese: の Village of Dragons) is a location in the Pokémon world, first mentioned in .

==In animation==
 
===Pokémon the Series===
==== ====
In , the Village of Dragons is a village in the Unova region located near Opelucid City. It is the hometown of and Shannon.

The Village of Dragons is a place where people raise and admire . An who lives there will also give out a Dragon-type Pokémon for s to . It was first mentioned by Iris in The Bloom Is on Axew! when she explained how she obtained her .

Statues of the and were built in the center of the village to commemorate them.

Dragon Pokémon roam around the village freely, such as Axew and its evolved form, . Not all the Pokémon here are Dragon type though: other Pokémon such as living in the surrounding forests.

Every year, there is a Pokémon battle tournament that Iris and her were seen competing at. Iris competed in it one time and did very well. She felt confident enough to challenge Opelucid City Gym Leader Drayden to a battle, but Drayden and his easily overpowered her and won.

According to Iris, most people from the village dream to become a Dragon Master.

Following on Iris's suggestion, the group visited the village in A Village Homecoming!. Iris caught up with the village elder, who gave a positive evaluation of her and Axew's progress. Iris's childhood friend Shannon was revealed to be training to become a , and she was currently raising two . However, one of the Zweilous evolved into a and began to panic. Iris and her Pokémon worked together to calm the Dragon-type down, and her efforts caught the attention of Drayden, who invited Iris to challenge the Opelucid Gym.

====Pokémon seen in the Village of Dragons====
 

==In the games==
In , when using Memory Link in Opelucid City, Drayden mentions the Village of Dragons as the place where he met Iris.

In Pokémon X and Y, an in the Lumiose City gives the and mentions that his partner learned the move in the Village of Dragons.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon Adventures===
==== ====
In One Way or Another, during the tournament battle between and Iris, she revealed that her hometown, the Village of Dragons, is in fact Blackthorn City in the Johto region. It is also where she had first met Drayden, who had taken her to the Unova region to train with him.

==Trivia==
In the animated series, the Village of Dragons is located in Unova, near Opelucid City. In the games, it is stated to be in a remote region far away from Unova.
According to the Pokémon Adventures , the Village of Dragons is Blackthorn City in Johto, a place known for its long history with Dragon Pokémon.

==In other languages==
